novelty.justification: The hypothesis introduces a new mechanistic relationship: the model allegedly "mis-attributes injected prior 'assistant' turns to itself and grants self-authored content elevated trust," making false self-authorship a distinct causal contributor to fabricated-history jailbreaks and motivating "Self-Authorship Neutralization." Searches using "many-shot jailbreak fabricated assistant history self-authorship," "LLM self-generated text recognition trust residual direction," and "conversation-history jailbreak attribution other AI defense" found the closest work in PANDAS (2025), Context Compliance Attack (2025), and JBShield (2025), which respectively exploit fabricated exchanges or manipulate generic jailbreak representations but do not connect attack success to internal self-recognition or authorship-conditioned trust. Moving from those attacks and prior self-generated-text recognition work to the claimed authorship-attribution-to-trust-to-compliance pathway requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although it remains an advance within established representation-steering and contextual-jailbreak frameworks rather than a new paradigm.
